answer: The strongest single control I know for this is continuous authentication during the session, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 12672 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the lagoon up to the light, weigh the vault of the attack, and keep the pulse of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
